actions.title: Send tracking updates immediately after shipping
actions.why: Buyers who see prompt tracking activity are less likely to open premature disputes before delivery.

actions.title: Use unique tracking numbers for each order
actions.why: Assigning distinct tracking numbers to each payment makes disputes easier for PayPal to resolve.

actions.title: Inspect and improve quality of MUG-SET-4
actions.why: Since this product generates clusters of disputes, fixing quality issues will reduce dispute volume.

actions.title: Auto-refund small disputes without response
actions.why: Disputes below the cost of your response time are better handled with quick refunds than contested.
